hits.title: Five Nights at Christmas
hits.description:
Five Nights at Christmas - Is Horror Survival game where you have to survive the nights in a snowy forest there will be 
some tasks that you need todo remember don't get cold and don't forget about the Snowman.
hits.howToPlayText:
[ WASD ] - Move
[ Mouse ] - Look
[ E ] - Intract

Just survive as many days as you can and make sure you didn't get freezed up!
